alternatives.question:
I was selected as one of the three overage players for my country's Olympic squad in Paris 2024.
Incredibly, I finished as the third-highest scorer of the tournament and won a silver medal.
My career has seen me move from Mainz 05 to Crystal Palace.

I scored the only goal in a European final to secure my club's first ever continental trophy.
Before this, I had also won the FA Cup and Community Shield in 2025.
I've played alongside the likes of Zaha, Eze & Guéhi.
